summary: Roberval Airport (YRJ) is a regional airport serving the city of Roberval in Quebec's Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region, situated on the western shore of Lac Saint-Jean. The airport gained international significance as a designated alternate landing site for NASA's Space Shuttle during missions to the International Space Station, a role it held due to its long runway and strategic mid-latitude position. Today it primarily serves general aviation, flight training, and occasional regional charter operations supporting the surrounding resort and tourism economy.
faqs:
Q: What is Roberval Airport mainly used for today?
A: The airport primarily supports general aviation, flight training, and charter flights, with limited scheduled commercial service. It remains an important facility for the Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean region's aviation needs.

Q: Is there regular scheduled commercial service to Roberval Airport?
A: Scheduled commercial service is very limited; travelers typically check current listings as routes can change seasonally. Many visitors use the airport for private or charter flights.

Q: Why was Roberval chosen as a Space Shuttle alternate landing site?
A: Its long runway, relatively isolated airspace, and mid-latitude position made it a viable emergency landing option during Shuttle missions to the International Space Station, alongside other Canadian and international sites.

Q: How far is the airport from downtown Roberval?
A: The airport is located just a few kilometers from the city center, making it a short drive to local accommodations and the Lac Saint-Jean waterfront.
transport_tips: Roberval Airport is only a short drive from downtown Roberval and the Lac Saint-Jean shoreline, so a rental car or taxi is usually sufficient for ground transportation. There is no regular public transit serving the airport, so arranging a vehicle in advance is recommended. Visitors combining a trip with the nearby Saint-Félicien Zoo or Val-Jalbert historic village will find the airport a convenient starting point.
local_tip: If you have time between flights, drive 15 minutes to the Roberval waterfront on Lac Saint-Jean for a quick walk along the promenade—locals say the sunsets over the lake are among the best in the region and make for a memorable end to any trip.
